sentences.en: Students don't read many books because of TV and comics.
sentences.zh: 学生们因为看电视而不怎么读书和看漫画。

sentences.en: I have grown out of the habit of reading comics.
sentences.zh: 我已经不再有看漫画的习惯了。

sentences.en: Reading comics is usually viewed as the pastime of children.
sentences.zh: 看漫画通常被视为孩子们的消遣活动。
